N Identify a location where homework will be done. 

N Make sure children have all the materials needed to complete homework assignments (e.g., pencils, era-sers, paper, dictionary, calculator). 

N Decide on the best time to do homework (e.g., right after school, just before or after dinner).
parts.hypothesis: Guidelines recommend no homework for first grade students and 10 minutes for second grade.
